integrity: The claim was reconstructed from the ruler-position identity and the factor-recentering lemma; embedded verifier implements independent factor-occurrence enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to finite literal Zimin words with ordinary contiguous, wholly internal factors; no statement is made for morphic encodings, cyclic windows, arbitrary prefixes, or other word classes. The all-order theorem is proved symbolically; finite tests do not establish novelty or infinity.
title: Complete string-attractor classification for finite Zimin words
